summary: Validate length in the new version only; after retirement add a NOT VALID check constraint so new rows are limited while existing long notes are kept.

stages.description: No schema change before deploy; the column stays text.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN note DROP NOT NULL

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
Enforce the limit for future writes without rewriting or validating existing rows.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD CONSTRAINT account_user_note_len CHECK (char_length(note) <= 255) NOT VALID
